31792-D.s: The bill amends the 2008 budget statement of the Fonds economische structuurversterking (FES), adjusting expenditure and revenue lines in the supplementary budget tied to the Najaarsnota. It also sets aside the 2007 closing balance rules and caps FES spending at total estimated revenue including the prior year's surplus, with entry into force on 1 December 2008.
q: Notwithstanding Article 4(3) of the FES Act, no more expenditure may be budgeted against the fund than the total of estimated revenues, including the prior year's realised surplus.

In afwijking van artikel 4, lid 3 van de Wet Fonds economische structuurversterking kunnen ten laste van het fonds in de begroting niet meer uitgaven worden geraamd dan het totaal van de geraamde ontvangsten.

31924-G.s: This bill is a closing budget act (slotwet) that amends the 2008 budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds, the VAT compensation fund, to reflect realised spending and receipts. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the change retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the BTW-compensatiefonds for the year 2008
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BTW-compensatiefonds voor het jaar 2008

31965-B.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), reducing the expenditure and receipts by about 270.9 million euro net, and sets the 2009 commitment amount for the general and supplementary grants at 15,597,429,000 euro. It takes effect on 1 June 2009 and the accompanying memorandum lists integration grants paid from the fund.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for the 2009 grant year at 15,597,429,000 euro.

Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet terzake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2009 vastgesteld op € 15 597 429 000.

32002.s: The bill extends the Natuurbeschermingswet 1998 and the Flora- en faunawet to the Dutch exclusive economic zone in the North Sea, so that Natura 2000 habitats and species there are protected and violations become punishable under Dutch criminal law. It also excludes fisheries activities covered by the common fisheries policy from these acts and clarifies provincial competence for protected areas.
32002.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by EU Birds and Habitats Directives and the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea, and explains that fisheries are left to EU competence.
q: This Act also applies in the exclusive economic zone, except for article 10, chapter III, title 2, section 1 and chapter IV.
Deze wet is mede van toepassing in de exclusieve economische zone, met uitzondering van artikel 10, hoofdstuk III, titel 2, paragraaf 1 en hoofdstuk IV.
d: exclusion of fisheries activities under common fisheries policy from certain provisions
p: Artikel II, onderdeel B (artikel 1a, lid 2) and Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 22a)
Fisheries activities under the common fisheries policy are carved out of the acts' scope in the EEZ, removing national regulatory reach over these activities.

parties: Asks whether the bill is needed given direct effect of the Habitats Directive, the Council of State's objections, and the status of the motion and fisheries consequences study.
The Council of State has noted that the bill seeks to bring plans, projects and activities within the EEZ under the Nature Conservation Act 1998 and the Flora and Fauna Act.
De Raad van State heeft geconstateerd dat het wetsvoorstel ertoe strekt dat plannen, projecten en activiteiten binnen de EEZ onder de gelding van de Nbwet 1998 en de Floraen faunawet te brengen.
Questions the exclusion of fisheries from the scope and requests the correspondence with the European Commission on this choice.
The PvdA members have question marks about the limitation of scope because fisheries as an activity is excluded.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben vraagtekens bij de beperking van de werkingskracht doordat de visserij als activiteit is uitgesloten.
Finds the government's reasoning for excluding fisheries illogical and urges following the Council of State and including fisheries under the Nature Conservation Act.

Because the government itself indicates that both reasonings – whether or not to exclude fisheries from the Nature Conservation Act 1998 now – can be defended, the SP members request following the Council of State's view.

Omdat de regering zelf aangeeft dat beide redeneringen – de visserij wel of niet nu te laten vallen onder de Nbwet 1998 – te verdedigen zijn, verzoeken de leden van de SP-fractie de zienswijze van de Raad van State te volgen.

Doubts the necessity of applying the Nature Conservation Act to protected sea areas, questions the permit requirement and the narrowing of discretion in Article 19a, and worries about uncertainty for existing and new activities.
For the VVD members the first question is whether it is necessary to make the Nature Conservation Act 1998 applicable to a number of provisionally designated Natura 2000 sites at sea.
Voor de leden van de VVD-fractie is het allereerst de vraag of het noodzakelijk is om de Nbwet 1998 van toepassing te laten zijn op een aantal voorlopig aangewezen Natura 2000-gebieden op zee.
Asks why fisheries are excluded from the Flora and Fauna Act and whether this complies with the Habitats Directive, noting the explanatory memorandum is thin.
This is striking and insufficiently justified.
Dit is opvallend en onvoldoende gemotiveerd.
Asks how a comprehensive management plan can be drawn up when fisheries, a main activity, is excluded, and seeks clarity on the relation between EU fisheries policy and Natura 2000 measures.
In what way can a comprehensive management plan, including existing use, be drawn up if one sector of it is excluded?
Op wat voor manier kan er een alomvattend beheerplan, inclusief bestaand gebruik, opgesteld worden als één sector daarvan uitgezonderd is?

Argues the bill does not correctly implement the Birds and Habitats Directives, wrongly invokes the Common Fisheries Policy, and that the government risks legal challenge before the Council of State; urges banning destructive fisheries in protected areas.
The PvdD members believe you wrongly invoke the CFP to legitimise your policy of not making fisheries subject to a permit under the Nature Conservation Act 1998.
De leden van de PvdD-fractie zijn van mening dat u ten onrechte het GVB opvoert voor de legitimatie van uw beleid om de visserij niet vergunningplichtig ingevolge de Nbwet 1998 te maken.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill extending the Nature Conservation Act and Flora and Fauna Act to the EEZ should be reconsidered on the fisheries exception, since EU law may leave member states competence to regulate fisheries impacts for Natura 2000 protection, and asked for clarification of the external effects of Natura 2000 designations. The government's reply maintained the choice to regulate fisheries through the Common Fisheries Policy, accepted clarifications on external effects and the memorandum, and made minor drafting corrections.
concerns: The Council considers it doubtful that fisheries activities can be fully excluded from the Acts given EU law, and that member states retain competence and obligations under the Birds and Habitats Directives.
The Council asks that the legal consequences and practical effects of the external effect of Natura 2000 designations on activities outside the sites be explained and clarified in the memorandum.
The Council suggests replacing the reference to the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU with a reference to the EC Treaty, since the Lisbon Treaty is not yet in force.

32395-D.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Fonds economische structuurversterking, reallocating spending and revenue lines after the spring memorandum. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2010, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement of the Fonds economische structuurversterking for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this act.
De begrotingsstaat van het Fonds economische structuurversterking voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

32780-F.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds), raising expenditure and receipts by EUR 12,904 thousand under article 1 for disease control and animal welfare, as shown in the attached supplementary budget. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 1 June 2011, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Is amended, as appears from the corresponding budget statement attached to this law
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat

33000-IIB.s: The bill fixes the 2012 budget (begrotingsstaat IIB) of the other High Colleges of State and the Governors' Cabinets (Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden, and the cabinets of the Governors of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten) and amends Article 1 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 accordingly. It is a budget-appropriation law with no new delegations of rule-making power to the executive.
q: Article 1 The budget statement (IIB) for the other High Colleges of State and the Governors' Cabinets for the year 2012, attached to this law, is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en de Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs (IIB) voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33100.s: The bill amends the Cultural Subsidies Act to remove the four-year subsidy designation regime (art. 4b) and to apply the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies (Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen) to cultural funds, excluding the ministerial power of annulment (art. 22). It also makes technical amendments to the Monuments and cultural property laws and the UNESCO 1970 implementing act, including moving customs supervision references to the General Customs Act.
33100.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as a response to budget cuts on the culture budget and as a more targeted allocation of subsidies based on criteria in a ministerial regulation, with the funds' independent decision-making protected from ministerial annulment.
p: Applies the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies to cultural funds' decisions while excluding the ministerial annulment power, reducing ministerial oversight of fund decisions in favour of their independence.
Removes the art. 4b designation regime and the associated long-term subsidy perspective for designated institutions, with eligibility shifted to ministerial regulation under art. 4a.

parties: Asks the government to confirm that the restructuring will not be reversed when funds are available and to explain the delay in aligning with the Kaderwet, and asks for a comparison of statutory versus ministerial-regulation options.

They agree with the proposed adjustment to the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen and endorse that the power of annulment would infringe independent decision-making, provided the decisions are substantive.

De leden stemmen in met de voorgestelde aanpassing aan de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen en onderschrijven dat het vernietigingsrecht inbreuk zou maken op de onafhankelijke besluitvorming, mits er sprake is van inhoudelijke besluiten.
Opposes the rapid cuts and merger of subsidy categories, which it says undermines security for major cultural institutions, and asks about job losses and expected numbers of objection procedures.
Large-scale and rapid cuts to culture are an irresponsible way of governing.
Het grootschalig en in hoog tempo bezuinigen op cultuur is een onverantwoorde manier van besturen.
Welcomes the restructuring and the budget cut, and favours a larger role for public and private partners and a smaller role for government.
The members can agree with the aim of a greater role for public and private partners and a more limited role for the government.
De leden kunnen zich goed vinden in het streven naar een grotere rol voor publiek en private partners en een beperktere rol van de overheid.

Asks whether the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen applies to the Raad voor Cultuur, how subsidies outside the Basis Infrastructuur are regulated, and what the government is doing to promote entrepreneurship.
The members further ask to what extent the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen applies to the Raad voor Cultuur.
De leden vragen voorts in hoeverre de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen van toepassing is op de Raad voor Cultuur.
Considers the cuts too steep and too fast, asks for gradual introduction, and asks the government to consult municipalities and monitor the impact on diversity and accessibility.
The members request the government to move to a gradual introduction of the new subsidy system in order to limit the damage as much as possible.
De leden verzoeken de regering over te gaan op een geleidelijke invoering van het nieuwe subsidiestelsel om de schade zo veel mogelijk te beperken.

33480-H.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the BES-fonds (Caribbean Netherlands fund) by adjusting appropriations and receipts, with the changes taking effect on 1 December. It is a routine supplementary budget adjustment accompanying the autumn budget memorandum, with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

33605-I.s: This is the 2012 Slotwet (final budget adjustment act) for the budget of the Crown (Koning I), changing the budget statement to reflect actual expenditure and revenue for 2012. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Because wage and price developments deviated somewhat from what was assumed when drawing up the budget, the budget amount was adjusted downward by 8.
Doordat de loon- en prijsontwikkeling enigszins afwijkt van datgene waarmee bij het opstellen van de begroting rekening is gehouden, is het begrotingsbedrag met 8 neerwaarts aangepast.

33640-J.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (Delta Fund) for 2013, adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures for water safety, freshwater supply, maintenance and experimentation. It sets the amendment's effective date and instructs ministries and authorities to implement it.
q: Whereas the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Delta Fund for the year 2013
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2013

33750-H.s: The bill establishes the 2014 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the BES-fonds, the fund for the public bodies of Caribbean Netherlands, at 32,709 thousand euros in both expenditure and receipts. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force as 1 January 2014 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Article 1: The budget statement for the budget fund for 2014 attached to this law is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat inzake het begrotingsfonds voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33930-H.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget statement of the BES-fonds (Caribbean Netherlands fund) by adding supplementary and closing-statement adjustments, raising the total from 32,093 to 35,688 thousand euro. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The budget statement of the BES-fonds for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34000-IIA.s: This bill adopts the 2015 budget statement for the Staten-Generaal (States General), setting appropriations in thousands of euros across the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint interparliamentary items. It does not delegate rule-making power or shift power away from parliament, courts or citizens.
q: The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2015 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34085-F.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting the Article 01 figures for animal disease control and welfare problems. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the act takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement of the Animal Health Fund for the year 2014 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this act.
De begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34475-C.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) to record the final realised figures for that year, including a small shortfall of 53 thousand euros in expenditure. It also fixes the commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants for 2015.
34475-C.j: The memorandum explains that the difference arises because the final distribution factor is not yet settled, so payments to provinces can differ from the budgeted amounts.
q: as long as the distribution factor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to the provinces may deviate from what is stated in the budget
zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de provincies kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat

34485-B.s: The bill amends the 2016 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), raising the commitment amounts and the expenditure and revenue totals by about 322 million euros in commitments and 363 million euros in expenditure and revenue. It also fixes the 2016 commitment amounts for the general grant, integration grants and decentralisation grants, and sets entry into force from 1 June 2016.
q: We ... have found, given that the need has arisen to amend the budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for 2016
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden ... dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2016

34550-I.s: This is the 2017 budget bill for the Crown (begrotingsstaat van de Koning), setting the expenditure estimate at €41.421 million, consisting of constitutional allowances to royal family members and functional expenditure of the King. The explanatory memorandum explains the allowance calculations and justifies the non-disclosure of specific spending under Article 41 of the Constitution, which leaves the King free to organise his household subject to the public interest.
34550-I.j: The memorandum justifies non-disclosure by the King's constitutional freedom to organise his household (Article 41 Grondwet) and protection of his private sphere, with the Raad van State advice supporting this reading.
q: The King organises his Household, with due regard to the public interest.
De Koning richt, met inachtneming van het openbaar belang, zijn Huis in.
p: Artikel 2 (functional expenditure) and memorandum on Article 41 Grondwet

Under Article 41 of the Constitution the Prime Minister may withhold information on specific Crown expenditure unless the public interest is affected, limiting parliament's ability to scrutinise these sums.

34550-XVIII.s: This bill adopts the 2017 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Housing and Civil Service (Wonen en Rijksdienst, XVIII), including agency budgets and the spending and revenue estimates per policy article. It does not itself create new delegations of rule-making power, and the memorandum concerns budget tables, agency financing and subsidies.
q: The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2017 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34730-I.s: The bill amends the 2017 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning), raising expenditure and receipts by a total of about 724 thousand euros in the first supplementary budget. It has no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
34730-I.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by wage and price adjustments and compensation for a pension premium increase, not by any new executive power.
q: The multi-year expenditure changes under articles 2 and 3 concern the 2017 wage and price adjustment and compensation for the rise in ABP pension premiums.
De meerjarige uitgavenmutaties op artikel 2 en 3 betreffen de loon- en prijsbijstelling 2017 en de compensatie voor de premiestijging van het ABP pensioen.

34730-XVIII.s: The bill amends the 2017 budget statements for Housing and Central Government Affairs (XVIII) and for the executive agencies, adjusting appropriations and receipts through a first supplementary budget effective from 1 June 2017. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and does not alter checks on the executive.
q: Having considered that a need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of Housing and Central Government Affairs (XVIII) and the budget statement on the agencies for the year 2017.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Wonen en Rijksdienst (XVIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen alle voor het jaar 2017.

34775-XVII.s: This bill sets the 2018 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), fixing commitments, expenditures and receipts in thousands of euros across five policy articles. It also entered into force on 1 January of the budget year with retroactive effect for later publication, and it contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Article 1 The budget statement for the year 2018 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34845-B.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by adjusting expenditure and revenue figures and fixing the commitment amounts for general, additional, integration and decentralisation grants. It also sets the entry-into-force date and retroactive effect of the amendment.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for the year 2017 is amended, as shown in the budget statement belonging to this law.
De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

35350-J.s: The bill amends the 2019 budget statement of the Deltafonds (Delta Fund) for water safety, freshwater supply, maintenance and water quality, shifting spending and commitments across articles and years. It contains no new delegation of rule-making power to the executive, and its effective date is retroactive to 1 December 2019.
q: The budget statement of the Delta Fund for the year 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35450-I.s: This bill amends the 2020 state budget of the King (first supplementary budget), raising the functional expenditure of the King by EUR 835 thousand and recording a EUR 247 thousand transfer on other budgets, giving a net change of EUR 1,082 thousand in commitments and expenditure. It is a purely budgetary adjustment that takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively from 1 May 2020.
35450-I.j: The memorandum justifies the increases as wage and price adjustments for 2020 and a settlement of the Military Household's 2019 final declaration, with no new powers claimed.
q: This concerns the difference between the advance paid and the final declaration of the Military Household for 2019, which in this case is a receipt.
Het betreft het verschil tussen het verstrekte voorschot en de einddeclaratie van het Militaire Huis over 2019, wat in dit geval een ontvangst inhoudt.

35925-B.s: The bill fixes the 2022 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at €35.6 billion and sets the commitment amounts for the general, supplementary, integration and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet. It enters into force on 1 January 2022, or retroactively from that date if published later.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for grant year 2022 at €30,515,140,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2022 vastgesteld op € 30.515.140.000.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2022 draft budget act for the Gemeentefonds (municipal fund) and raised no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments and refers to attached annexes, without addressing any substantive objections.

36250-J.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (J) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across seven budget articles. It also sets the amount in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 December 2022.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (J) for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds (J) voor het jaar 2022

36350-I.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 budget of the King (begrotingsstaat van de Koning), adding 1.727 thousand euro to the constitutional allowance to members of the Royal House (article 1) and 2.685 thousand euro in expenditure to functional expenditure (article 2) via a wage and price adjustment. The bill takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 June 2023.

36410-L.s: This bill sets the 2024 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Nationaal Groeifonds, the national growth fund, with expenditure and receipts of about €1.57 billion across knowledge development, research and innovation, and infrastructure. The explanatory memorandum describes the fund's project allocations, including conditional commitments and departmental routes, but the bill itself delegates no rule-making power.
q: The budget statement attached to this act concerning the budget fund for the year 2024 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat inzake het begrotingsfonds voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion on the draft budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds for 2024 and found no remarks, advising that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The opinion is accompanied by the government's nader rapport of 18 September 2023, but since the opinion raised no points, the reply contains no responses to specific concerns.

36600-K.s: This bill formally adopts the 2025 budget statement for the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (DMF), setting out expenditure, commitments and revenue in thousands of euros. It also sets the effective date and publication terms of the budget law.
q: The budget statement attached to this law for the budget fund for the year 2025 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat inzake het begrotingsfonds voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering made no remarks on the 2025 budget bill for the Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport states that some budgets need amendments, which are attached as annexes rather than set out in the text.

36600-XXIII.s: This bill sets the 2025 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth, with total expenditure and receipts for policy article 31 on energy supply and climate change, and the budgets of the Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit agency. The accompanying memorandum describes the budgetary instruments, subsidy schemes, climate fund spending and agency funding without itself creating new executive discretion.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this law for the year 2025 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

36725-C.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), raising the general-fund and decentralisation-grant commitment amounts and increasing expenditure and revenue by about EUR 226.5 million, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2025. It otherwise sets the fund's commitment figures in euros and leaves the entry into force to a royal decree-style publication clause.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant is set for the 2025 grant year at EUR 3,562,582,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet (Fvw) ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2025 vastgesteld op € 3.562.582.000.

36800-I.s: This bill adopts the 2026 budget statement of the King (Koning), setting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros for the constitutional allowances to royal family members and the functional expenditure of the King as head of state. It takes effect on 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2026 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued blanco advice on the 2026 budget bills, raising no objections to the budget statements for the Koning (I) and other ministries and funds. The Minister of Finance's reply notes that some budgets need amendments and refers to annexed changes, without addressing any substantive legal objection.

36915-B.s: This bill amends the 2026 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), the first supplementary budget, adjusting commitment and expenditure amounts for the general grant, additional grants, integration grants and decentralisation grants. It sets the commitment amounts for the 2026 grant year and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2026.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of the municipal fund for the year 2026 is amended, as shown in the statement annexed to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2026 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.
